get_hardware: run a check to detect available GPU hardware using nvidia-smi or default to CPU
check_pytorch_gpu: check if PyTorch can detect and use a GPU device on the system
check_tensorflow_gpu: check if TensorFlow can detect and list available GPU devices on the system
format_time: convert a number of seconds into a human-readable hours minutes and seconds string
get_log_dir: retrieve the LOGGING_DIR environment variable and raise an error if it is not set
